# AI Atlas by Turtleand

> A curated directory of AI tools with detailed profiles, use cases, and honest evaluations.

Canonical: https://atlas.turtleand.com/

## Explore

- [AI Tsunami Tracker](https://atlas.turtleand.com/tsunami/): Assess readiness across AI usage, automation, adaptability, independence, and systems thinking.
- [AI tool map](https://atlas.turtleand.com/islands/): Browse AI tools by category and use case.
- [AI Impact Map](https://atlas.turtleand.com/ai-impact-map/): Explore how AI pressure reaches industries and roles unevenly.
- [The Turtleand Loop](https://atlas.turtleand.com/productivity-loop/): Use Learn, Apply, Position, Adapt to choose the next compounding action.

## Tools

Each entry links to the tool's website. The [structured catalog](https://atlas.turtleand.com/ai-tools.yaml) includes tool statuses and use notes.

### Active

#### Chatbot
- [ChatGPT](https://chat.openai.com/) (OpenAI's conversational AI)
- [Gemini](https://gemini.google.com/) (Google's AI assistant)

#### Agents and Code
- [OpenAI Codex](https://openai.com/codex/) (OpenAI’s coding agent.) [Turtleand repositories](https://github.com/turtleand)
- [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/) (AI coding assistant in terminal)
- [ChatGPT Dots](https://chatgpt.com/get-dot/) (An always-on agent in ChatGPT.)
- [ChatGPT Docs](https://openai.com/business/plugins/documents/) (Create and edit documents with ChatGPT.)

#### Images
- [ChatGPT Image](https://chat.openai.com/) (OpenAI's image generation in ChatGPT)

#### Research and Education
- [NotebookLM](https://notebooklm.google/) (AI-powered learning notebook)

#### Local & Infrastructure
- [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/) (Model repository & community hub)

### Experimental

#### Agents and Code
- [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai/) (Open-source AI coding agent.)
- [Orca Orchestrator](https://github.com/stablyai/orca) (Runs coding agents in parallel Git worktrees.)
- [Hermes Agent](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent) (Open-source AI agent framework with memory, skills, tools, messaging, and scheduled tasks)

#### Voice
- [ElevenLabs](https://elevenlabs.io/) (AI voice and audio tools.)

#### Local & Infrastructure
- [llama.cpp](https://github.com/ggerganov/llama.cpp) (Local LLM inference engine)
